description_preview:
Description
AWS Lambda MicroVMs is at the forefront of the next evolution in serverless computing. Launched to enable developers to run isolated sandboxes with full lifecycle control, Lambda MicroVMs are powered by Firecracker, the same lightweight virtualization technology behind over 15 trillion monthly Lambda function invocations. The service is rapidly growing as the default platform for executing untrusted and AI-generated code in hardware-isolated environments with sub-second launch and resume capabilities.
We are seeking Software Development Engineers interested in driving the evolution of the Lambda MicroVMs platform. Our teams build and operate the end-to-end systems behind Lambda MicroVMs, from the ingress layer that securely routes customer traffic to MicroVM backends, to the orchestration services that launch, suspend, resume, clone, and terminate millions of MicroVMs weekly, to the metering systems that track usage for accurate billing at scale. Together, these systems deliver the serverless experience customers expect: built-in availability, automatic scaling, and zero infrastructure management.
In this role, you will work on developing features that empower customers to run per-user and per-session isolated environments without managing clusters or idle capacity. You will build systems that enable use cases such as sandboxed execution for AI agents, interactive development environments, multi-tenant SaaS isolation, and secure code execution, all with the operational simplicity of serverless. There is a tremendous opportunity to innovate at the intersection of virtualization, serverless, and AI. You will work with languages such as Java, TypeScript, Python, and Rust. Come challenge yourself in our team-oriented atmosphere, and watch yourself grow with one of the most innovative and fastest-growing areas in AWS.
Key job responsibilities
Serve as a key contributor and subject matter expert for critical components of the Lambda MicroVMs platform, demonstrating deep technical knowledge of virtualization, isolation, and distributed systems
Design and implement features across the service stack, including lifecycle orchestration, resource management, networking, security isolation, and performance optimization
Define functional and technical feature requirements, and translate them into detailed solution architectures that meet requirements for functionality, performance, scalability, reliability, and adherence to development goals and principles
Deliver and operate highly available, scalable, low-latency services in production with measurable impact on customer experience, supporting millions of concurrent MicroVM sessions
Drive improvements across the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance of the team's software
Collaborate with senior engineers on system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance decisions
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team's technical culture and growth
Demonstrate versatility by multitasking and quickly adapting to new development environments and changing business requirements
Basic Qualifications
3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Experience programming with at least one software programming language
Preferred Qualifications
3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Company Overview
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
Group/Division
Enabling the movement toward advanced chip design, KLA's Measurement, Analytics and Control group (MACH) is looking for the best and brightest research scientists, software engineers, application development engineers and senior product technology process engineers to join our team. The MACH team's mission is to collaborate with our customers to innovate technologies and solutions that detect and control highly complex process variations—at their source—rather than compensate for them at later stages of the manufacturing process. With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Our MACH team develops leading-edge solutions for patterning process analytics and control technologies, thereby providing customers with critical insight at the feature level, field level and cross-wafer analysis. Our teams also develop advanced modeling simulation, data analytics and process control modeling technologies. As a member of the MACH team, you’ll be joining the most sophisticated and successful process-control company in the semiconductor industry--working across functions to solve the most complex technical problems in the digital age.

description_preview:
Description
The Fleet Performance Optimization (FPO) organization builds the intelligence layer for Amazon Robotics manipulation workcells. We own the systems that select what work a robot should attempt, monitor how it performs, and close the loop by improving models with every induct. Our platforms serve Sparrow, Cardinal, FlexCell, and Robin workcells that handle millions of packages across Amazon's fulfillment network.
We Operate Across The Full ML And Data Lifecycle
Work Selection Intelligence — Eligibility scoring and predictions (likelihood-to-empty, damage prediction, time-to-process, pick eligibility) that feed into work planners, identifying which totes and items reach each workcell.
Data & Observability — A common datalake collecting telemetry from every automated and manual workcell, fleet monitoring that detects performance degradation in real time and alerts Ops, and deep-dive tooling that enables engineers and scientists to investigate workcell behavior.
ML Lifecycle — Annotation orchestration, model training pipelines, production monitoring, and deployment infrastructure that keeps models current across the fleet.
Predictive Models — Science-developed foundational models applied to eligibility, fleet performance forecasting, and dynamic floor policies that adapt to changing conditions without manual intervention.
Our systems process tens of millions of events daily, serve real-time scoring at workcell-runtime latency, and directly impact fulfillment cost per unit.
Key job responsibilities
As an SDE on FPO, you will design, build, and operate distributed systems that sit at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and large-scale data processing. You will work closely with scientists, program facilators, and partner engineering teams to translate research into production systems that operate reliably at fleet scale.
Depending On The Team, Your Work May Include
Building high-throughput, event-based scoring services that process real-time inventory signals across 10+ warehouses and hundreds of workcells
Designing config-based annotation orchestration systems that onboard new ML data pipelines without code changes
Developing model deployment infrastructure spanning edge devices, cloud inference services, and planning systems
Building fleet monitoring systems that use VLMs and statistical methods to detect performance anomalies and surface root causes
Creating unified data exploration and visualization tools used daily by engineers, scientists, and operations
Implementing ongoing learning systems that intelligently select which data to collect based on inference outcomes
Extending our foundation models, which are the backbone for multiple prediction tasks
Own your systems end-to-end — from design through production operations — and your work will have direct, measurable impact on workcell throughput, quality, and cost.
A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits for you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Maternity and Parental Leave Options
Paid Time Off (PTO)
401(k) Plan

Why FPO?
Impact at scale — Your code runs on hundreds of workcells processing millions of packages. Improvements compound across the fleet.

Breadth of problems — From real-time scoring services to VLM-based monitoring to data platform design, the technical surface area is wide and deep.

Experience designing and building distributed systems or data-intensive applications
Experience with the full software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations

3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
Experience with ML infrastructure (training pipelines, model serving, feature stores, monitoring)
Experience with event-driven architectures and stream processing at scale (Kinesis, Kafka, SQS)

Global trade is one of the hardest, highest-stakes industries in the world, and the software that runs it has never kept up.
Pax is changing that.
Pax is the AI control tower for global trade. Enterprises like Verkada, Glossier, Yamaha, and Kodak run their trade compliance on us: the intelligence layer that queries fragmented data, audits continuously in the background, drafts and files intelligently, and surfaces the money that's been quietly slipping away for years. We started with duty drawback, a $10B/year opportunity hiding in plain sight, and we're now building the entire operating system for how enterprises stay compliant and claw back every dollar they're owed.
Here's The Platform We're Building, Product By Product
Duty drawback: recover tariffs paid on goods later exported, returned, or destroyed. (Live.)
IEEPA / reciprocal tariff recovery: claw back refunds on the new wave of reciprocal tariffs. (Live.)
Entry & export audits: an AI audit agent that reviews every entry line by line and catches errors before they ever reach CBP. (Shipping now, and you could own pieces of it.)
with more on the roadmap as we build out the full control tower.
Tariffs have been top of mind for everyone. Companies have gone from paying 25% to 145% tariffs. There's never been a better time to make a real world impact on real businesses.
Who's building this
Pax was started by people who lived this problem.
Penny Chen
(CEO) holds a PhD from MIT and built optimization algorithms at Flexport and on Amazon's supply chain last-mile team.
Chris Le
is a repeat founder, previously at Brex, TikTok, and Amazon, where he worked on supply chain optimization for last-mile delivery. We started Pax because we saw billions in refunds sitting unclaimed while working alongside the importers who were owed them.
We're well-capitalized, we already have real enterprise customers, and we're looking for an early-career software engineer to take real ownership of the products above, early enough that your work shapes the company and the $10B+ industry we're transforming.
What you'll do
Own real features end-to-end: API design, backend logic, frontend UI, and everything in between
Build tools that make complex regulations feel like magic
Work directly with customers to understand what matters, then ship fast
Build with LLMs to solve real problems for real businesses, not imaginary ones
What Your First 90 Days Look Like
Week 1: Ship a real feature to production.
First 30 days: Deliver an end-to-end project alongside a founder, something agentic, powered by LLMs.
60 days: Independently own a vertical end-to-end, from spec to ship.
90 days: Work directly with our enterprise clients, forward-deploying, incorporating their feedback, and building product in front of them.
You'll write systems that reconcile tens of millions of dollars in annual trade volume against thousands of pages of complex federal regulations, and turn PDFs of customs entries into structured, refundable data.
The ideal candidate
Has built and shipped something they're proud of. Show us the GitHub, the side project, the thing you couldn't stop working on. We care more about what you've built than where you've worked.

Is genuinely curious about building with LLMs, whether or not you've shipped with them before, and eager to learn fast

If you've built something you're proud of, we want to see it.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

Experience with ASP.NET, Web Forms, .NET Framework, and/or modern .NET.
Experience with TypeScript, Angular, React, or other modern front-end frameworks.
Experience developing or consuming REST APIs or service-based integrations.
Experience with Azure DevOps, build/release pipelines, CI/CD, or automated deployment practices.
Experience with cloud or monitoring tools such as Azure, AWS, Application Insights, DataDog, or similar platforms.
Experience improving application performance, scalability, reliability, or maintainability.
Experience working with ERP, construction, accounting, scheduling, purchasing, sales, CRM, or other complex business workflow systems.
Familiarity with secure coding practices, API management, authentication/authorization concepts, and production support processes.

At Favor, we are committed to building a world-class team that shares a passion for products that make a difference with modern, clean code. What You'll Do
Assist in research and fact finding to develop or modify applications.
Fix bugs and perform updates to the code base while working closely with senior engineers.
Participate in the planning and execution of development projects.
Partner with cross-functional technology teams to integrate solutions.
Responsible for all phases of development, testing, and deployment of native iOS applications.

Description
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
The AWS Hardware Engineering team creates server designs for Amazon’s innovative web services. Our designs are industry-leading in frugality and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of the AWS business and millions of customers who use AWS today. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems, and build architecturally sound, high-quality components to enable AWS to realize critical business strategies.
The AWS Firmware team drives system innovation in the servers used by all of Amazon Web Services, including EC2, S3, CloudFront, etc. Our engineers solve the hardest problems that fuse software, hardware, and the cloud. We take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry.
We are looking for an Embedded Software Development engineer to build and own the server related firmware. As an embedded software development engineer in this team, you will work with a team of world-class software developers who thrive on creating innovative, scalable solutions for real-world data center infrastructure problems. You will be part of development efforts to build, validate, and support firmware in diverse technology domains from embedded software to large-scale distributed software systems, using proprietary and open source technologies.
Why it matters
Public cloud IT services represent the majority of growth in the overall IT services market and will continue to do so for several years to come. The scale of AWS, combined with an understanding of how our software and hardware is used, creates a unique opportunity for component customizations that will directly benefit our customers.
Why you will love it
You will work with engineers across the company to build software for the next-generation platform. You will have a direct impact on our bottom line and the ability to deliver improvements for our developers. You will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team. You will have ownership for the implementation of your work. You will see direct product improvements based on the results of your work.

description_preview:
Our mission is to make biology easier to engineer. Ginkgo is constructing, editing, and redesigning the living world in order to answer the globe’s growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. Our bioengineers make use of an in-house automated foundry for designing and building new organisms.
About the Role:
Ginkgo Bioworks is constructing the world’s first "Total Autonomous Lab"—a facility where scientific work is requested by code and executed by robots, 24/7. We are looking for a
Software Intern
to help build the digital brain of this lab. You will work with
Catalyst
, our proprietary software stack that orchestrates fleets of Reconfigurable Automation Cells (RACs). This role is ideal for software engineers who want to apply their skills to physical systems or computational biologists who want to move beyond analysis into autonomous execution.
Responsibilities
Enable "Protocols as Code": Develop and refine Python-based protocols using the Catalyst Client to control liquid handlers, plate readers, and robotic arms.
Build the AI Scientist: Assist in the development of Catalyst Agent, our LLM-based interface that allows scientists to launch experiments using natural language.
Integrate Lab Data: Work on data pipelines that automatically harvest, structure, and upload experimental data from RACs into our data lake for AI model training.
Develop Device Drivers: Help integrate new hardware instruments into the Catalyst ecosystem, writing the drivers that allow our software to "talk" to new lab tools.
Preferred Qualifications
No college degree necessary but some skills in coding or related areas required.
Strong proficiency in Python; experience with hardware control or APIs is a plus.
Enthusiasm for "Lab-in-the-Loop" technologies where AI models drive physical experimentation.
Interest in biological data standards and laboratory automation.

Actual pay within this range will depend on a candidate's skills, expertise, and experience. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental & vision coverage, health spending accounts, voluntary benefits, leave of absence policies, 8 paid holidays in addition to a full-week winter shutdown and unlimited Paid Time Off policy.
It is expected that all Internships are onsite five days a week.

Voyage is a Maison for Mind Computing — the first deep tech couture house, engineering non-invasive neural interfaces as objects of desire. Applicants can expect a creative, experimental environment focused on pushing the boundaries of human–machine interaction.
~
Most ML roles begin with "which architecture fits this data." We like to start with "what is this data, actually."
There's no established benchmark for this, no textbook preprocessing pipeline, no prior work to sanity-check yourself against. You're not fitting a model to a known modality – you're the first person deciding what the modality even is, both structurally (what's actually sitting in the raw signal) and functionally (how those patterns turn into something usable). That's a different kind of endeavour than most ML roles: less "optimize against a metric," more "feel out a pattern nobody's named yet, then prove it's real." Voyage poetics.
What we need
Strong deep learning fundamentals, with a feel for designing architectures around new inductive biases
Sharp sense for representation learning and working with unlabeled data
Ability to reason about signal-to-noise situations and integrate multiple modalities
Experimental rigour and speed under high uncertainty – creating and testing hypotheses quickly, with direct oversight of hardware and data collection
Experience building foundational models, designing tokenizers, and handling continual learning despite domain shift is highly useful
Who we're looking for
We care more about people who developed neurotech interest from an ML fundamentals background than people who started in neurotech and backed into modeling.
On Voyage
ML with us means self-supervised approaches to calibrating across modalities that were never designed to talk to each other. You'll have a direct line to the hardware and data collection loop
—
when the data looks wrong, you're close enough to the sensor stack to find out why, not waiting on someone else to tell you. The playbook for building in Mind Computing has not yet been written — you will be one of the first to do so.

description_preview:
About Us
MintMCP
helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.
Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.
We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.
AI-Native Startup
We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team, write code, review PRs, and handle sales, marketing, and deal ops on the same gateway we sell to customers. We are building an entire company operating system around them, and you will help build it.
Traction
Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 30+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.
The Job
You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it.
Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers.
We hire across levels, from strong early-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship.
About You
You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals.
You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience.
You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity.
You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents.
You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs.
You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast.
You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem.
You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process.
Nice to have:
Developer-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale.
Background in security, identity, or permission systems.
Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks.
Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure.
What we offer:
Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers.
Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell.
Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow.
Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.
We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.
We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!
How We Operate
Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.
Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
Role Scope
Build the software behind data center robotics: task planning, fleet coordination, and integration with company systems.
Ship the autonomy glue: perception outputs, navigation stacks, and task logic composed into reliable behavior.
Own the operational tooling: monitoring, teleoperation fallback, and diagnostics for robots at remote sites.
Integrate robotics data into the platform: missions, exceptions, and outcomes queryable like everything else.
What We're Looking For
The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.
You've shipped software for robots or autonomous systems in production.
You've worked with ROS or equivalent middleware on real hardware.
You engineer for remote failure: recovery, fallback, and observability built in.
You've integrated robot systems with enterprise or facility software.
You debug hardware-software boundaries without a lab bench.
Bonus: Navigation and SLAM. Fleet orchestration. C++, Python, or Go. Simulation (Gazebo, Isaac).
We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

The Engineering Excellence Intern will work closely with cross-functional team members such as engineering managers, engineering analysts and data engineers to support the Engineering Excellence team. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Python, or R) is a plus.
Interested in healthcare technology and process improvement
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Eastern or central time zone preference to align with availability of the team
No prior experience required; curiosity and willingness to learn are essential
Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

Mentorship from experienced software engineers, data engineers and analysts.
Exposure to the full product development lifecycle in a leading healthcare technology organization.
Opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects impacting software engineering.
Professional development workshops and networking opportunities.
Potential for academic credit (subject to university approval).

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.
We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.
We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!
How We Operate
Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.
Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
Role Scope
Build the facilities data pipeline: ingestion, transformation, and serving of telemetry from every site.
Ship the connectors that speak the field's languages, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and vendor APIs, reliably.
Own data quality in code: validation, gap detection, and backfill tooling.
Serve the consumers: clean APIs and datasets for dashboards, controls, and ML.
What We're Looking For
The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.
You've shipped production data pipelines and owned them on call.
You've integrated with industrial protocols or ugly vendor APIs and made them reliable.
You test data code properly: correctness, latency, and gaps.
You debug across the stack, from a flatlined sensor to a slow query.
You work fast with modern tooling and AI-assisted development.
Bonus: Time-series systems. Go, Python, or TypeScript. Industrial and IoT data. Grafana ecosystems.
We are committed to pay equity and transparency.
Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you
did not
receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application-- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.
Compensation Range: $269K - $317K

description_preview:
Why USAA?
At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.
Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.
We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.
The Opportunity
We’re hiring a forward-thinking and dedicated Software Engineer Lead to join a dynamic, startup-minded team within the Investment Experience Technology organization at USAA, part of the Technology group. This is your opportunity to be part of a mission-driven company while working in an agile, fast-paced environment that values innovation and bold thinking. You will lead solutioning and development to deliver a new LOB Member experience to serve our member’s financial needs and play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction of our new investment services line of business.
You’ll work with a modern tech stack—including Go, Java, APIs, OpenShift, and a wide range of USAA technologies—to help build the next generation of investment solutions. Our goal? To deliver differentiated, digital-first experiences that empower both our members and financial advisors with seamless, intelligent, and scalable tools. If you're passionate about building impactful technology, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to help shape the future of investment services, we’d love to meet you.
We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be
in the office 4 days per week.
This position will be based in San Antonio; TX or Plano; TX. Relocation assistance is
not
available for this position.
What You'll Do
Design, develop, code, and test complex technical solutions.
Investigates and resolves complex application and system technical problems and production issues through troubleshooting techniques.
Continually improves operations by conducting complex systems analysis and recommending changes in policies and procedures.
Prepares and installs complex solutions by determining and designing system specifications, standards, and programming.
Follows the software development lifecycle.
Participates in design reviews and learns key system design principles.
Mentors junior engineers and may begin mentoring peer engineers; Review teammates' code.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
What You Have
Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
8+ years of software development experience, including 2+ years leading enterprise technology initiatives.
6+ years delivering technology solutions across the full SDLC.
Deep expertise in Java, JavaScript, Spring Boot, OpenShift, and modern software engineering practices.
Enterprise-level experience leading Java-based enterprise application development.
Expertise designing and implementing Dynamic UI and Server-Driven UI (SDUI) frameworks using React, Redux, and Spring Boot, including UI metadata contracts, rendering frameworks, component libraries, design systems, personalization, and reusable user experiences.
Deep experience designing and implementing scalable API-first solutions using Spring Boot, REST APIs, Docker containers, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong experience designing and leading cloud-native solutions using OpenShift, AWS, containerization, observability, automation, and modern platform engineering practices.
Demonstrated leadership building highly scalable, secure, resilient, and performant enterprise applications, including threat modeling, authentication/authorization, secure coding practices, and vulnerability remediation.
Deep experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures using Kafka, including real-time streaming, asynchronous processing, topic design, and event-driven integration patterns.
Experience integrating UI, APIs, and workflow orchestration platforms such as Flowable, Camunda, or similar BPM technologies.
Experience leading integrations with enterprise data platforms, Snowflake, data warehouses, and real-time or batch processing pipelines.
Experience with modern engineering practices including TDD, automated testing, Git, GitLab CI, Maven, and Gradle.
Experience supporting wealth management, brokerage, investment services, financial planning, advisor workflows, or regulated financial services environments.
Experience with Documentum and DocuSign integration is desirable.

The salary range for this position is: $127,310- $243,340
.

About The Company
We are building the rails to bring Wall Street settlement into the 21st century. Current settlement infrastructure wastes billions in trapped capital and operational inefficiency, forcing institutions to maintain massive reserves, limiting market liquidity, and creating systemic risk that grows more dangerous as markets become increasingly global and interconnected.
Backed by $40M from leading crypto and fintech investors, we are bringing together the best from both Wall Street and Ethereum to reimagine the infrastructure that underpins the financial system.
Key Responsibilities
Build beautiful, performant front-ends — turn designs into applications with the professionalism and aesthetics to delight institutional users
Translate complex financial logic into code — work alongside product teams to understand and capture the nuances of their industry in our workflows
Meet institutional standards — harden code to ensure it meets clients' rigorous requirements for security and robustness
Explore new products — deep-dive into new areas of the financial system alongside domain experts, exploring ideas and helping to shape future products
Requirements
You ship, not just code: directly responsible for taking major features or entire products from idea to production, owning the full lifecycle of significant technical projects
Full-stack TypeScript: experienced with TypeScript both front-end and back-end (blockchain development experience is not necessary)
You build with AI: modern AI coding tools are central to how the engineering team works; you've woven them deeply into your workflow and know how to get real leverage
Startup mindset: adaptable, self-directed, and at ease with ambiguity — early-stage startup experience preferred
Nice to Have
Experience with data grids, particularly AG Grid
Benefits
Medical, dental, and vision healthcare
401(k)
Generous PTO

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack + AI
reason: Stack +7; Title fit +12; US +10
description_preview:
About Calvis
Calvis is making the trillion-dollar physical security industry AI-native. Today the industry is outdated, fragmented, and run on pen and paper. With Calvis, Humans + AI work together to secure the world.
Our marketplace connects businesses with vetted security guards who work every shift using our AI copilot. It briefs them, takes their reports, and helps them do a great job. Meanwhile, every shift generates data that continuously makes our AI better.
We enhance guards with robots and AI video monitoring, making Calvis the only all-in-one security offering on the market.
Clients across the country, from critical infrastructure to manufacturing facilities, trust Calvis to help keep them safe.
Why join?
Very small team, in person, in office. Work directly with the CEO and CTO.
The business has grown fast over the last year, and our growth rate is only accelerating.
Complete ownership and autonomy. You own what you work on, end to end, and you decide how to build it. We have plans, but autonomy is the point: it means looking around corners and building for what's coming before it's on our roadmap.
Your work ships fast and lands in the real world with real guards.
Everything is still early. The systems you build here become the foundation an entire industry runs on.
The role
Build agents that understand the physical world: directing guards, robots, and sensors working together on a live site.
Own products end-to-end. You get to understand the guards and customers who use what you build, figure out what they need, and ship.
Work full stack across every surface we have: backend server, web dashboard, native iOS and Android apps, and the agent infrastructure underneath all of it.
Take what’s working and scale it. Our products have real usage and real revenue but are still early. You’ll harden them, iterate against live data, and turn v1s into systems thousands of sites depend on.
Who you are
Worked at a high-growth startup before. You thrive in chaos, change, and uncertainty.
You work hard, and you’re wired in. The business, the problems, and the thing you’re building stay on your mind because you actually care.
You build with AI every day and treat staying at the frontier as part of the job. You’re constantly learning from new models, tactics, and workflows, and folding them into how you work.
Product mindset. You don’t just ship code, you dig into what users are actually struggling with and care about the experience you build.

description_preview:
About Fluidstack
We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.
We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.
We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!
## How We Operate
Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done. - Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible. - First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
## Role Scope
Qualify next-generation compute: GPUs, servers, and racks tested against the deployment standard before the fleet sees them. - Build and run the benchmark suites: performance, power, and thermals characterized under real workloads. - Break things on purpose: stress, fault injection, and endurance runs that find the weaknesses early. - Write the qualification reports that become fleet standards: configs, firmware, and known issues documented.
## What We're Looking For
The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.
You've qualified, validated, or debugged server or GPU systems hands-on. - You benchmark rigorously: reproducible methods, controlled variables, honest numbers. - You've root-caused hardware failures across silicon, firmware, and system levels. - You script your work: automation over checklists. - You've worked with vendors on bugs and gotten fixes shipped.
Bonus: NVIDIA or AMD accelerator platforms. BMC and firmware depth. Thermal and power characterization. Linux systems depth.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

About Us
Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.
Full Stack Engineer, App Framework & E-Commerce
The Opportunity
We're doing an AI-first engineering rebuild for a company that already has an audience of 100M+ people. This is a zero-to-one build with no legacy constraints. You're not joining to maintain someone else's code. You're here to build the experiences that define what the Beast community can do beyond watching content, from user accounts and home page to e-commerce flows that convert at scale. You'll work across the full stack, frontend and backend, leveraging AI to ship features at a speed that wasn't possible before.
The Product
You'll be working, as part of a small and fast-moving team, on the product surfaces that every user touches: account, home page, and e-commerce. These aren't isolated features. They form the connective tissue of the entire experience, and they need to work flawlessly across a wide range of devices, network conditions, and user contexts. That means:
User-facing surfaces (account flows, home page, checkout, and purchase experiences) that must be fast, reliable, and conversion-optimized across devices.
A frontend that feels seamless whether a user is on a flagship iPhone or a mid-range Android on a slow network.
An e-commerce flow where performance directly impacts revenue: every second of load time and every friction point in checkout has a measurable cost.
What You'll Do
Build and ship user-facing features across account, home page, and e-commerce surfaces using AI coding tools, contributing to a velocity that redefines what a small engineering team can deliver.
Take ownership of your features end to end, from development through release, using AI-facilitated QA processes and tooling to maintain high engineering quality.
Care about performance — page load times, checkout conversion, crash rates, and render latency are numbers you track and actively work to improve.
Collaborate closely with your teammates, contributing to a culture of high standards, fast iteration, and continuous learning.
Who You Are
AI-Native: You're already burning through tokens and running coding agents daily to multiply your output.
Full Stack Engineer: 3+ years of hands-on experience building consumer-facing products across frontend and backend, with a strong eye for design principles and user experience.
Performance Obsessed: You notice when something feels slow, you know how to find the bottleneck, and you have a track record of moving the numbers — crash rates, render latency, load times, checkout conversion.
Product Minded: You care about why you're building something, not just how. You use data and A/B experiment results to inform your decisions and push back when the approach doesn't make sense.
Hands-on experience with at least one mobile or frontend framework (React Native, Swift, Kotlin, or equivalent) and one backend language. Bonus points for e-commerce or marketplace experience, familiarity with modern AI coding tools and AI-facilitated development processes, and prior work at a consumer-scale company.
Benefits
The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team
We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance
Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
Company-provided technology package
Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

• 5+ years of experience testing websites or web applications.
• Ability to think like both a business analyst and an end user.
• Strong understanding of how modern websites and web applications function.

• Excellent attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.

• Familiarity with browser developer tools.

• Experience testing accessibility (WCAG), performance, and SEO-related functionality.

• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, or similar project
management platforms.
What Makes Someone Successful in This Role
The ideal candidate doesn't simply verify that buttons work. They ask questions like:
• Does this workflow make sense to a first-time visitor?
• What happens if a user enters unexpected information?
• Are there business scenarios that weren't considered?
• Will this feature work correctly across different browsers and devices?
• Are there edge cases that could impact the client?
They proactively identify issues, think critically about user experience, and help improve the
overall quality of every project we deliver

Job Description: Senior QA Engineer (Paid)
About GoQuant
GoQuant is a financial technology company dedicated to providing high-performance trading solutions for digital assets. We empower professional traders and institutions with a comprehensive suite of tools, including GoTrade (Order Execution and Management), GoMarket (Market Data), GoRisk (Portfolio and Risk Management), and GoDark (private, dark-pool trading). Our focus is on delivering lightning-fast execution, ensuring private and secure trading environments, and offering sensible, fixed-fee structures. By integrating with a wide array of venues including centralized and decentralized exchanges, prime brokers, and market makers, GoQuant enables clients to maximize their trading potential with clean, reliable data and cutting-edge technology in 24/7 digital-asset markets.
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to serve as the first layer of QA management across GoQuant's digital-asset trading platform. This is not a peer-level IC role — you will review and formally sign off on other QA engineers' test plans and results, hold authority to block releases that do not meet quality standards, and own the go/no-go recommendation for production deployments. The ideal candidate brings prior hands-on experience in financial and trading systems — including digital-asset market structure — and a proven track record of driving continuous automated testing, measurable release criteria, and reporting integrity in low-latency, high-stakes environments. You will own test strategy across GoTrade, GoMarket, GoRisk, and GoDark; establish the cross-product regression and dependency discipline the platform requires; and partner closely with engineering, product, and operations to ensure our systems meet the reliability, accuracy, and performance standards required for institutional digital-asset trading.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as QA sign-off authority — review test plans and results from other QA engineers and own the go/no-go recommendation for production releases.
Define measurable release exit criteria (automation coverage, defect-escape rate, severity gates) and enforce CI/CD as a mandatory release gate.
Own cross-product regression and dependency testing across GoTrade, GoMarket, GoRisk, and GoDark — net-new feature testing never substitutes for full-platform validation.
Build and maintain automated test frameworks (Python, JavaScript; C++ a plus) and lead the migration from manual to continuous automated testing.
Architect latency, throughput, and benchmarking tests for low-latency, high-frequency trading environments.
Validate trading workflows end-to-end — order routing, execution, on-chain/off-chain settlement, risk checks, market data accuracy, and dark-pool confidentiality — across integrated venues and protocols.
Provide senior-level input on testability, reliability, and failure modes in architecture and design reviews.
Own production monitoring, observability, and root-cause analysis for trading and financial system incidents.
Establish testing standards and mentor QA engineers on technical depth and reporting discipline.
Ownership & Judgment
Escalate unknowns, blockers, or unclear requirements immediately rather than proceeding on assumption.
Treat “tested” as synonymous with independently verified, never self-reported without evidence — and hold that standard when clearing or blocking a release.
Required Skills & Qualifications
5+ years of QA engineering experience in financial or digital-asset trading systems (OEMS/EMS, market data, PMS/RMS, exchange connectivity).
Hands-on experience testing digital-asset trading systems — 24/7 markets, on-chain vs. off-chain settlement, dark-pool or non-displayed liquidity mechanics.
Proficiency in Python and JavaScript for test automation frameworks (e.g., pytest, Jest); C++ familiarity a plus.
Proven track record building and scaling automated testing frameworks and CI/CD-enforced release gates (e.g., GitHub Actions) for complex, distributed systems.
Expert knowledge of testing methodologies — unit, integration, performance, load, and regression — in low-latency environments.
Experience with trading protocols and exchange/venue connectivity (FIX, WebSocket, REST APIs).
Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) in production trading environments.
Strong API, database, and data-integrity testing experience (Kafka/RabbitMQ pipelines, PostgreSQL/Redis/InfluxDB) in financial systems.
Experience with security, audit, or compliance testing in regulated financial services.
Demonstrated experience reviewing others' test work and making release go/no-go decisions.
Track record of diagnosing complex production issues in high-stakes systems, with strong communication skills.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Skills & Qualifications
Experience testing high-frequency or low-latency trading applications, validating sub-millisecond performance.
Experience with DEX/AMM mechanics, on-chain custody workflows, and decentralized exchange connectivity.
Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Chaos engineering, fault injection, and resilience testing for mission-critical infrastructure.
Experience with synthetic market data generation and trading-scenario simulation.
Prior experience formally managing or building out a QA team.

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. description_preview:
Overview
Hexagon’s Autonomous Solutions Division is looking for a
Manufacturing Test Engineer
to join our high-tech engineering and manufacturing company that is committed to customer service excellence and continuous improvement. Reporting to the Team Lead, Manufacturing Support, you will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the innovative manufacturing process and test solutions responsible for ensuring that the highest quality products are delivered to our customers with industry-leading service levels. As part of our Manufacturing Process Engineering team, you will have the opportunity to exercise your software and hardware knowledge when supporting the various manufacturing systems used across the Autonomous Solutions product lines. It’s a unique opportunity to become proficient with not only the innovative manufacturing systems but also the cutting-edge products themselves.
The Location: Hexagon is a global companty with offices around the world. This position is based in
Tucson, Arizona, United States.
Responsibilities
As a
Manufacturing Test Engineer
you will be responsible for the following in your real time support of Production issues:
Providing real-time support to in-house production and supplier manufacturing sites by:
Investigating and resolving manufacturing test issues while preventing reoccurrence
Delivering advanced product troubleshooting support to production as required
Enhancing manufacturing test solutions including hardware and software
Monitoring test yields, investigating deviations, and taking appropriate action to resolve, including making manufacturing hardware or software improvements or proposing product or process changes
Analyzing product updates and implementing changes to the manufacturing hardware or software
Defining, performing, and optimizing preventive maintenance of manufacturing hardware
Continuously improving the manufacturing support process by identifying and correcting reoccurring issues
Providing off-hours real-time support to remote contract manufacturing sites located in various time zones
Qualifications
Must-Have:
Excellent verbal and written English language communication skills
Engineering Degree or Technical Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics
5+ year relevant technical experience, including internship
C++ or C# software development experience
Python development experience
Ability to design, modify & troubleshoot test hardware (electrical/mechanical)
Valid passport and ability and willingness to travel both nationally and internationally
Able to safely lift up to 15kg (33lb)

Seneca Resources is seeking two highly experienced DevSecOps Engineers to join a mission-critical enterprise modernization initiative. This role is ideal for professionals who are passionate about integrating security throughout the software development lifecycle while building scalable, automated, and cloud-native platforms. As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will collaborate with development, operations, and cybersecurity teams to design, implement, and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), container platforms, and AI-driven automation solutions. You will play a key role in improving deployment velocity, strengthening application security, automating compliance, and enhancing operational resilience across enterprise cloud environments. Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable CI/CD pipelines supporting enterprise software delivery.
Lead release management activities across Development, SIT, CAT, and Production environments for major releases, patches, and upgrades.
Automate build, deployment, testing, monitoring, and release processes using DevSecOps best practices.
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines using SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and automated compliance validation.
Collaborate with software development teams to enforce secure coding standards and remediate vulnerabilities early in the SDLC.
Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, and CloudFormation with secure configuration management.

Integrate AI-driven automation into existing DevOps and testing frameworks to improve reliability and deployment quality.
Manage cloud infrastructure, monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational observability.
Support RESTful APIs and microservices architectures deployed in cloud-native environments.
Troubleshoot CI/CD pipeline failures, cloud infrastructure issues, application deployments, and production incidents.
Administer enterprise databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL Server as needed.

Mentor engineering teams on DevSecOps principles, cloud security best practices, and secure application development.

description_preview:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.
She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
The next step is to speak to Jack.
Job Title
Forward Deployed Engineer
Salary
Not Disclosed
Company Description
Strala is a high-growth AI company backed by Founders Fund that is rebuilding the insurance industry’s foundation. They have reached multi-seven-figure ARR in less than a year and are currently scaling agentic AI systems to transform how major insurance carriers handle complex claims decisions.
Job Description
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Strala, you will own the end-to-end deployment of multi-modal, agentic AI systems for enterprise insurance carriers. You will combine deep technical execution in Python and LLMs with high-level client strategy, acting as the primary partner for senior executives while shipping production code that impacts millions of claims.
Location
San Francisco, USA
Why this role is remarkable
Join a Tier 1 backed startup (Founders Fund) growing 50% month-over-month with multi-seven-figure ARR achieved in under a year.
Deploy cutting-edge agentic AI into production environments where your work directly drives faster decisions and massive cost savings for large institutions.
Work alongside a world-class team from institutions like Harvard, Berkeley, and Palantir in a high-intensity, meritocratic, in-person San Francisco environment.
What You Will Do
Individually scope, build, and deploy multi-modal AI agents using Python and LLMs, managing the entire lifecycle from initial prototype to production go-live.
Act as the primary technical point of contact for senior client stakeholders, including CIOs and VPs, to align AI adoption with business priorities.
Collaborate with the core platform team to translate client insights into new product features, ensuring seamless integration with complex legacy enterprise APIs.
The ideal candidate
Possesses 2+ years of experience in technical, client-facing roles such as Forward Deployed Engineering, Agent Engineering, or as a Founding Engineer.
Demonstrates mastery of Python and modern AI/ML tooling, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade agentic AI or LLM-based workflows.
Thrives in high-stakes, fast-paced environments, operating with a founder mindset to solve complex problems and explain technical concepts to non-technical executives.
Who are Jack & Jill?
Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
How does this work?
Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.
We never post fake jobs
This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

Ground Systems Integration Engineer
Location: Hybrid – Arvada, CO or Seattle, WA (3 days/week onsite)
Clearance Required: Active or previously held TS/SCI
Compensation: Approx. $120,000 to $180,000 (depending on experience)
Employment Type: Full-time
About The Role
Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking a Ground Systems Integration Engineer to join a mission-driven team simplifying satellite operations. In this hybrid role, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating new satellite platforms and flight software into our client's mission management platform. You’ll work closely with a multidisciplinary team and customer stakeholders to translate complex mission requirements into robust, scalable solutions.
This focus of this role will be low-level software integration, debugging, and problem-solving in ambiguous, real-world environments. The ideal candidate needs to be comfortable working with incomplete documentation, encrypted packet formats, and non-machine-readable inputs (like screenshots and PDFs).
Key Responsibilities
Integrate satellite vehicles and flight software into the mission management platform.
Collaborate with customers to decompose mission requirements and engineer integration solutions.
Work with industry-standard protocols such as CCSDS, CSP, CFDP, XTCE, and MIB.
Troubleshoot and debug low-level software and hardware interfaces.
Support the broader product suite by contributing to scalable, maintainable integration solutions.
Handle encryption and packetization tasks, including working with XDC files and custom formats.
Thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where creative problem-solving is essential.
Qualifications
Proficiency in Python, C++, or Java.
Experience with real-time embedded systems and hardware-software integration.
Familiarity with satellite communication protocols (e.g., CCSDS, CSP, CFDP).
Understanding of command and telemetry standards (e.g., XTCE, MIB).
Knowledge of encryption algorithms (e.g., AES-256 GCM, NSA Type 1).
Preferred experience with AWS services (Lambda, ECS, EKS, EC2, etc.).
Comfortable with Git/GitHub and open-source tools.
Strong analytical and debugging skills.
Highly adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity.
Independent self-starter with a bias for action.
Excellent communicator—able to distill complex technical information for diverse audiences.
Detail-oriented with a high standard for software quality and maintainability.
Collaborative and easy to work with—team culture is key.
Preferred Background
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in satellite command and control systems or similar complex integration environments.
Experience with flight software, ground systems, or embedded systems is a strong plus.

Our Senior Software Engineer is a key member of the engineering staff working across the organization to deliver a frictionless payments experience for our customers while maintaining the highest standards of protection, compliance, and availability. Description
Help us build the factory that builds the satellites connecting the world. As a SysDE on the SCADA Infrastructure and Platform team, you'll design and deliver multi-platform, multi-tenant infrastructure services that enable Amazon Leo's satellite manufacturing operations.
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.
We are seeking an innovative and solution-oriented System Development Engineer (SysDE II) to join our team to develop innovative solutions and automated pipelines for deploying SCADA infrastructure and platform as a service. This role combines hardware, software, OT and IT stack development for SCADA infrastructure and platform within an active satellite manufacturing facility.
In this position, you will primarily work on backend code for IAC, CDK, and pipelines of full SCADA Infrastructure and Platform lifecycle to abstract SCADA deployment and configuration from SCADA Application development and provide engineering excellence for reliability and disaster recovery while ensuring optimal developer experience for the SCADA application developers and system integrators. Ideal candidate will have direct hands-on experience developing industrial applications using Ignition, deploying Ignition SCADA Platform through modern DevOps practices at scale, or hands-on deployment of industrial software tools to AWS with secure connectivity to equipment on the plant floor.
Key job responsibilities
Design and implement scalable infrastructure for industrial software platforms (SCADA, torque tool management, engineering applications, asset management) across AWS and on-premises environments
Develop CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code for provisioning and lifecycle management of factory software systems
Build automated deployment frameworks and self-service provisioning tools for multi-tenant industrial applications
Architect cloud-native and hybrid solutions supporting OT/IT convergence and manufacturing interoperability
Create monitoring, observability, and security frameworks for OT infrastructure following industry best practices
Lead troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and incident resolution for manufacturing system availability
Drive continuous improvement for deployment speed, reliability, and cost optimization
Collaborate with production, engineering, IT, and procurement teams on escalations and cross-functional initiatives
Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
A day in the life
This highly collaborative position interfaces across multiple Amazon Leo teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
The successful candidate will have strong experience in automation technology development, with the ability to understand and contribute to platform as a service development, reliability metrics, and developer experience and testing within critical automated manufacturing systems.
The role requires hands-on technical expertise combined with strategic thinking to drive continuous improvement and deliver business-aligned solutions in an active production facility.
The typical schedule requires 5 days in-person per week, participation to on-call and weekend rotations to align with Leo production shifts.
About The Team
The Ground Support Equipment Automation (GSEA) team is responsible for designing and commissioning automation and tooling for Satellite testing and production. This in-house team of engineers and support technicians work directly with satellite designers, testers, and manufacturing engineers to solve unique problems in high-volume satellite production.

Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
Experience with Linux/Unix
Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

Experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering
Experience with distributed systems at scale
Experience utilizing AWS cloud solutions in a DevOps environment
Knowledge of a front-end language (Javascript, CSS, HTML, etc.)
Knowledge of database systems and SQL
